timed out after 5m0.000371139s (excluding download) waiting for app "3cd4243e-f6ba-4e91-bcbc-89ac7f689c89" (acl-app-1) on device "edge-dev" to reach RUNNING state (last state: RESOLVING_TAG)

Claude's conclusion:
Confirms no `"context"` import in any of the three downloader files — matching the ledger's prior finding exactly. This is the identical, unfixed bug.

**Root cause:** `acl-app-1`'s content tree (`dfd88fc7-ab70-4e0f-8230-956bc0dea0b9`, image `lfedge/evetest-ubuntu-ctr:1.0`) is permanently wedged in `State:101` (RESOLVING_TAG) with empty `ContentSha256` and no error — `/run/downloader/ResolveStatus/` has zero entries for it, meaning the resolver goroutine never even published a status (consistent with hanging inside its first `remote.Get`/tag-resolve HTTP call). Meanwhile the sibling `acl-app-2-image` content tree for the same test, using the same image (but a digest-pinned reference, not a tag), resolved and fully downloaded without issue (`State:108`, 100% progress) — showing the hang is specific to the tag-resolution path, not the registry or network. `zedbox` is alive and not watchdog-tripped, confirming a wedged goroutine rather than a crash, and `pkg/pillar/cmd/downloader/resolveconfig.go`, `resolveimg.go`, and `syncop.go` still have no `"context"` import on this branch, so the OCI tag-resolve HTTP call has no deadline/timeout. This is the exact, extensively documented recurring issue in the ledger — the same `RESOLVING_TAG` wedge with no `ResolveStatus` and no `context` import — first identified 2026-11-15 (run #19) and recurring repeatedly since (2026-11-17, 2026-11-23 run #42 against `acl-app-1`/`flowlog-test-app` specifically, and others), making tonight's occurrence at least the 5th instance of this known, unfixed bug. No PR diff was provided for this investigation, so no relatedness verdict applies.
